summary.text: On Sarpadia, the Ice Age approaches after the Brothers' War and Urza's Golgothian Sylex, bringing dwindling resources and fighting among former allies, until the dwarven kingdom falls to orcs and goblins and the Ebon Hand falls to the thrulls.

Tev, guilt-ridden and exiled after the Brothers' War, loses his sister Tymolin to the Farrelites and the Ebon Hand, and his spark ignites as he becomes the dragon Tevesh Szat, who vows to destroy the Sarpadian empires.
Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, is the last kingdom to fall, ending Sarpadia's story.
